set stat = $$$OK try { Do ..JavaGateway.%Import(..JarFile)

$$$TRACE("IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Encryption.Operation.EncryptFile.OnMessage: Unencrypted file has been deleted: " _ pRequest.unencryptedDirectory _ pRequest.unencryptedFilename) Set pResponse = ##class(Ens.StringResponse).%New() Set pResponse.StringValue = pRequest.encryptedDirectory_pRequest.encryptedFilename
